taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: WebAuthn registration and assertion verification — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect registration/authentication option generation, challenge persistence/consumption, RP/origin configuration, verification library and credential-to-account storage.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned test authenticators/accounts. Compare a normal ceremony with an expired/reused challenge and a response associated with the wrong local account. Trace verified credential identity and required user verification to the account session; preserve actual authenticator and browser prerequisites.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A counter anomaly alone is not universal proof of a cloned passkey. Platform/synced credential behavior and the relying party's threat model matter; do not infer authentication bypass from decoded client data.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use supported verification of the intended RP/origin/challenge and bind credential/account/purpose with one-use transaction state. Retest valid registration/login, the evidenced wrong binding and the declared user-verification requirement.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
